title: Salesforce SSO Authentication Failure After Certificate Rotation
known_causes: Incorrect IdP metadata uploaded to Salesforce
validation_steps: Check failed authentication count returns to baseline
Confirm business users can access CRM

title: Application Server Exploitation or Suspected Remote Compromise
symptoms: Unauthorized access to an application server
Evidence of exploitation through an exposed service
resolution_steps: Contain the affected application or server
Preserve relevant logs and forensic evidence
Identify the exposed service or compromised credential
Apply the approved remediation or patch
Validate that suspicious activity has stopped
validation_steps: Confirm the affected service is contained
Verify that the vulnerability or access path has been removed
Check that monitoring no longer detects suspicious activity
